label: SCG I.22 non-unified quiddity union is sourced only in the esse
paraphrase: At a selected world, for every bearer x: if x's represented esse e is per se necessary in the dependence sense (PER_SE_NECESSARY_2), x is ontically identified with e, e is joined to x's proposed quiddity q, q is x's genuine quiddity, and e and q are not one per se, then the joining of e to q depends on some s which is not other than e (constructively: not s ≠ e, rather than s = e). Conditional on n.6's union causation, both n.4 cases and n.2's per se clause, without n.2 coverage. The self-sourced residual is not refuted here.
